text: A bakery sells loaves at 3.40 each and rolls at 0.85 each. On Monday it sold 212 items for a total of 466.85. How many loaves and how many rolls were sold? Show your working.

Three friends, Ade, Bea and Cal, each own exactly one pet: a dog, a cat and a parrot. Ade is allergic to fur. Bea's pet does not talk. Cal has never owned a cat. Who owns which pet? Explain each step.

I need to schedule four 30-minute interviews between 9:00 and 12:00. Interviewer P is free 9:00-10:30, interviewer Q is free 10:00-12:00, and each candidate must be seen by both P and Q with at least a 15 minute gap between their two interviews. No interviewer can do two interviews at once. Produce a schedule or explain why it is impossible.
A car's fuel economy is listed as 6.2 litres per 100 km. Convert that to miles per gallon using US gallons, and then to miles per UK gallon. Show the conversion factors you use and round sensibly.

A train leaves station A at 08:10 travelling at 90 km/h. A second train leaves station B, 255 km away, at 08:40 heading towards A at 120 km/h. At what time do they pass each other, and how far from A? Walk through the reasoning.

If every widget costs 4.20 to make and sells for 7.00, and there is a fixed monthly cost of 3,360, how many widgets must be sold in a month to break even? What if the supplier raises the unit cost by 15 percent? Reason step by step.

A recipe for 6 people needs 450 g of flour, 3 eggs and 300 ml of milk. I am cooking for 14 people but I only have 900 g of flour. What is the largest number of people I can cook for with the flour I have, and how many eggs and how much milk will I need? Explain.
Five runners finished a race. Nia finished before Omar but after Petra. Quinn finished last. Rafi finished immediately after Petra. List the finishing order and state which clue fixed each position.

A water tank holds 1,800 litres. Pipe A fills it in 3 hours, pipe B fills it in 4.5 hours, and a drain empties a full tank in 6 hours. If all three are open and the tank starts empty, how long does it take to fill? Show the rate calculation.

I have a 250 ml bottle of a 12 percent solution and want to dilute it to 5 percent using water. How much water do I add, and what is the final volume? Then, if I only have a 400 ml container, what is the strongest concentration I can make using the whole bottle?

A meeting must include at least one person from each of three teams. Team X has members a and b, team Y has c, d and e, and team Z has f. a refuses to attend with c, and d is only available if e also attends. What is the smallest valid attendee list, and how many valid lists of that size exist? Explain.

The temperature at dawn was minus 4 degrees Celsius and rose steadily by 1.5 degrees per hour until noon, then fell by 2 degrees per hour. At what time in the afternoon did it return to the dawn temperature, and what was the highest temperature in Fahrenheit? Reason it out.

A rectangular garden is 3 metres longer than it is wide, and a 1 metre path runs around the outside of it. The path's area is 40 square metres. Find the dimensions of the garden. Set up the equation and solve it step by step.

A library fines 0.25 per day for the first week overdue and 0.50 per day after that, capped at 15.00. A book was returned with a fine of 11.75. How many days overdue was it? Could there be more than one answer? Explain.

I want to leave home at the latest possible time and still reach the airport gate by 14:20. The drive takes 35 minutes in normal traffic but 55 minutes if it rains, and there is a 60 percent chance of rain. Parking and the shuttle take 15 minutes, security takes 25 minutes, and I want a 10 minute buffer. Work out the departure time for both cases and tell me which one I should plan around and why.

Convert a running pace of 5 minutes 20 seconds per kilometre to minutes per mile, and then work out how long a half marathon (21.0975 km) would take at that pace. Show each step and give the final time in hours, minutes and seconds.

A box contains red, blue and green marbles. There are twice as many red as blue, and three more green than red. Altogether there are 43 marbles. How many of each colour? Verify your answer by adding them back up.

Four tasks, A, B, C and D, must be done in one day by two workers. They take 3, 5, 2 and 4 hours respectively. B cannot start until C is finished, and each worker can only do one task at a time. What is the shortest possible time to finish all tasks, and which assignment achieves it? Explain why nothing shorter is possible.

A monthly subscription costs 9.99 and an annual plan costs 89. If I expect to keep the service for 14 months, which is cheaper overall, and by how much? At what number of months does the annual plan start to win? Reason carefully about partial years.
Two candles of equal length are lit at the same time. One burns out in 4 hours, the other in 6 hours. After how long is one candle exactly twice the length of the other? Show the algebra.

A courier has to deliver to points on a straight road at kilometres 2, 7, 11, 15 and 22, starting from kilometre 0 and returning to 0 at the end. Each delivery takes 5 minutes and the van averages 40 km/h. Assuming the obvious route, how long does the round take? Then explain whether any other order could be faster and why.

A shop offers either 20 percent off the whole basket, or buy two get the cheapest free. My basket has items at 30, 18 and 12. Which offer saves more? Would the answer change if I added a fourth item at 25? Show the calculations for both.

A digital clock shows hours and minutes in 24-hour format. How many times in a day does the display read the same forwards and backwards, like 13:31? Count carefully and explain how you enumerated the cases without missing any.

My laptop starts the day at 100 percent battery. Each video call uses 22 percent of the battery per hour while note taking uses 8 percent per hour. I have three one-hour calls today and need to take notes for the rest of the working day of 8 hours. Will the battery last, and if not, at what point does it run out? Explain the arithmetic.
